messages:
Hannah: quick sync - I'm preparing a compact migration note + decision table for the Optimize toolkit: when to choose prefetch vs micro-batch vs bulk batch. Will include TypeScript + Python examples and a short mapping for legacy qprofiles (legacy-q1 -> q-lowlat, legacy-q2 -> q-throughput). Need SDK review + one QA harness run.

Vik: nice. can you add a tiny streaming example showing prefetch ON vs OFF and note memory delta? infra wants the numbers.

Hannah: yup. TS snippet (to go in examples):
```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD })
await client.optimize.prefetch({
  model: 'rwd-7b-quant',
  prefetchKeys: ['conversation_context'],
  batchSize: 4,
  quantProfile: 'q-lowlat',
})
```

Priya: I'll review the Python sample. Also add a one-line fallback pattern: runtime route to non-quant variant if profile not found.

Hannah: Python snippet: `client.optimize.prefetch(model='rwd-7b-quant', prefetch_keys=['conversation_context'], batch_size=4, quant_profile='q-lowlat')` — will expand in PR.

Marco: perf note: for short sequences (<=32 tokens) prefetch reduced median latency ~12% in our small harness. For very long sequences (>512) batching dominated throughput. I can attach the harness CSV.

Vik: good to have the CSV. also flag: our Go SDK uses `OptimizeClient()` now; mention that in a compatibility footnote.

Hannah: added compatibility footnote and mapping table for legacy qprofiles. Also wrote a tiny ops checklist: canary 5% traffic for 24h, monitor p95 token latency and memory RSS, rollback on >20% regression.

ci-bot: CI started for PR #5078 - link-checker queued.

Priya: reviewed Python snippet and left a minor style nit (use Client(api_key=...) import).

Hannah: fixed nit and pushed. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5078 (assigning @Vik @Priya).

qa-bot: QA harness queued. Command used: `tools/eval/harness --suite=prefetch-vs-batch --model=rwd-7b-quant --tokens=8,32,512 --runs=20 --out=artifacts/5078.zip`

Marco: quick numbers from my run: 8 tokens median 9.8ms/token (prefetch), no-prefetch 11.2ms/token. 512 tokens throughput 320 tok/s with batching, prefetch slightly higher memory. Attaching summary: https://artifacts.redwood.dev/qa/5078/summary.csv

ci-bot: link-checker completed for PR #5078 - status: success :white_check_mark:. Spellcheck flagged one word in migration note; fixed.

Vik: LGTM from SDK side (TS + Go compatibility note). Left a small comment about example path in the sidebar.

Priya: Approving python snippet.

Hannah: merged PR and backfilled a tiny redirect for the batching guide. Thanks all! :sparkles:

Vik: filing a follow-up to add a short paragraph in the console docs describing where prefetch metrics appear (per-key cache hit rate).

Hannah: will watch telemetry for 48h and open an incident if regressions. Closing thread.
